metrics.definition: scheduled flights, over the mart
metrics.name: scheduled flights
metrics.sql: select sum(scheduled) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: cancellation rate, over the mart
metrics.name: cancellation rate
metrics.sql: select sum(cancelled) / sum(scheduled) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: completion factor, over the mart
metrics.name: completion factor
metrics.sql: select 1 - sum(cancelled) / sum(scheduled) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: diversion rate, over the mart
metrics.name: diversion rate
metrics.sql: select sum(diverted) / sum(scheduled) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: on time rate, over the mart
metrics.name: on time rate
metrics.sql: select sum(on_time) / sum(flown) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: mean arrival delay, over the mart
metrics.name: mean arrival delay
metrics.sql: select sum(arr_delay_sum) / sum(flown) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: median arrival delay, over the mart
metrics.name: median arrival delay
metrics.sql: select median_from_histogram as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: mean scheduled block, over the mart
metrics.name: mean scheduled block
metrics.sql: select sum(crs_elapsed_sum) / sum(flown) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: mean actual block, over the mart
metrics.name: mean actual block
metrics.sql: select sum(actual_elapsed_sum) / sum(flown) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: mean padding, over the mart
metrics.name: mean padding
metrics.sql: select sum(padding_sum) / sum(padding_flights) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: padding share, over the mart
metrics.name: padding share
metrics.sql: select sum(padding_sum) / sum(padding_block_sum) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: reported late aircraft share, over the mart
metrics.name: reported late aircraft share
metrics.sql: select sum(cause_late_aircraft_sum) / (sum(cause_late_aircraft_sum) + sum(cause_carrier_sum) + sum(cause_nas_sum) + sum(cause_weather_sum) + sum(cause_security_sum)) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: reported carrier share, over the mart
metrics.name: reported carrier share
metrics.sql: select sum(cause_carrier_sum) / (sum(cause_late_aircraft_sum) + sum(cause_carrier_sum) + sum(cause_nas_sum) + sum(cause_weather_sum) + sum(cause_security_sum)) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: reported nas share, over the mart
metrics.name: reported nas share
metrics.sql: select sum(cause_nas_sum) / (sum(cause_late_aircraft_sum) + sum(cause_carrier_sum) + sum(cause_nas_sum) + sum(cause_weather_sum) + sum(cause_security_sum)) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: reported weather share, over the mart
metrics.name: reported weather share
metrics.sql: select sum(cause_weather_sum) / (sum(cause_late_aircraft_sum) + sum(cause_carrier_sum) + sum(cause_nas_sum) + sum(cause_weather_sum) + sum(cause_security_sum)) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: reported security share, over the mart
metrics.name: reported security share
metrics.sql: select sum(cause_security_sum) / (sum(cause_late_aircraft_sum) + sum(cause_carrier_sum) + sum(cause_nas_sum) + sum(cause_weather_sum) + sum(cause_security_sum)) as value from mart_carrier_month

metrics.definition: inherited share, over the mart
metrics.name: inherited share
metrics.sql: select sum(inherited_minutes_sum) / sum(arr_delay_pos_sum) as value from mart_inherited_month
